problem: Ixx is written as 1.30×106 mm4. Read literally this is 1.30×106 = 137.8 mm4, not the second moment used in the calculation. The exponent is missing and the unit is not formatted.

The displayed equation (1/(2Ai))∮qi/t ds = (1/(2Aj))∮qj/t ds is incomplete for two cells sharing a wall. If qi and qj are the cell redundant flows q0, the shared wall carries qb + qi − qj, and the twist-rate integral for cell i must subtract the qj term on the shared wall and include qb. As written, it contradicts the next sentence that the shared wall carries qi−qj.
fix: Write the full condition: for cell i, θi = (1/(2Ai))[∮i qb/t ds + qi∮i ds/t − qj∫shared ds/t], with the matching expression for cell j, and set θi = θj. Equivalently, use the actual net shear flow in every wall, including qi−qj on the shared wall.

problem: The text says an open flange has no twist rate. An open section does have a twist rate; it simply has no enclosed area, no Bredt circulation q0, and no separate closed-cell compatibility equation. A student can take away the false idea that open members do not twist.
fix: Say: an open flange has no enclosed area and no independent Bredt circulation q0, so it does not give a separate closed-cell twist equation. It twists with the section but does not impose a closed-loop compatibility condition.
